excerpt.zh: 栖居于[Root.GetName]殖民地地下的外星人在夜间派出了数组突袭部队。它们摧毁了殖民地的一处主要设施，并在安保部队做出回应前就逃回了地下。
excerpt.en: The aliens living below our colony on [Root.GetName] have been sending out small raiding parties from their tunnels at night. Their attacks have destroyed one of the colony's major installations, and before our forces could respond the raiders had vanished und

texts.zh: 栖居于[Root.GetName]殖民地地下的外星人在夜间派出了数组突袭部队。它们摧毁了殖民地的一处主要设施，并在安保部队做出回应前就逃回了地下。
texts.en: The aliens living below our colony on [Root.GetName] have been sending out small raiding parties from their tunnels at night. Their attacks have destroyed one of the colony's major installations, and before our forces could respond the raiders had vanished underground.
